description: The ministry's receipt register records the submission on a date 12 days after the sponsoring body's internal approval, with no subsequent action for 74 days.

independence_note.reasoning: One official register; no independent second record of the same dates was located.

alternative_readings: The register may record receipt of a covering letter rather than the substantive submission, which would weaken the timing inference.
A 74-day silence could reflect an unrecorded informal exchange.
